name: Marijn Bent
title: Technical lead & product-minded developer
summary: I build web products and the systems behind them. At WordProof I combined backend development with leading a distributed engineering team. My work spans reusable integrations, APIs, deployment and migration tooling, business websites and personal applications. I also teach technical subjects and enjoy helping people understand how things work.

entries.title: WordProof
entries.subtitle: Co-founder & technical lead
entries.body: Built the initial platform and led a distributed frontend/backend team while continuing to implement core features. Developed Laravel services for queued timestamp processing, billing and PDF certificates, and migrated the application to AWS/serverless infrastructure. Built reusable PHP SDKs and embeddable certificate components. Implemented the Yoast SEO integration, built WordPress and Shopify integrations, and collaborated on Wix integration work. Coordinated technical planning and delivery with the team and external engineers.

entries.title: Web platform engineering
entries.subtitle: Architecture & delivery
entries.body: Developed an API-first platform with a separate serving runtime, schema migrations and release checks. Implemented authentication, request validation, idempotent processing and deployment diagnostics. Added checkpointed migration tooling and review/preview steps before publishing changes.

entries.title: Studiozoek
entries.subtitle: Business owner & developer
entries.body: Build and run business websites and the tools behind them. Work includes a Hub/CRM, campaign and review workflows, supporting web infrastructure and operational tooling.

entries.title: Eduvision / blockchain education
entries.subtitle: Technical teaching
entries.body: Prepared and delivered practical blockchain teaching, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, wallets, transactions, consensus and smart contracts. Developed interactive exercises and used course reflections to improve the sequence and clarity of explanations.

entries.title: Blocklab / Open Energy Hub
entries.subtitle: Thesis & collaborative engineering
entries.body: Worked on “The Smart Smart Meter” thesis and collaborated on an open-source distributed database for smart-meter data. Contributed dashboard and API work, Raspberry Pi setup and data handling.

entries.title: Obsidian Print
entries.subtitle: Public plugin / TypeScript
entries.body: Printing for Obsidian notes, selections and folders, with platform-specific behavior on desktop and mobile.

entries.title: Prepped
entries.subtitle: Personal application / Astro, React, SQLite
entries.body: Self-hosted recipe management with imports, cook logs, meal planning and household sharing. Recent work includes improving the ingredient layout.

entries.title: BookLite
entries.subtitle: Maintained fork / TypeScript, React, Fastify
entries.body: Maintain a fork of a self-hosted digital library with Kobo synchronization, metadata and reading tools. My recent work includes settings and runtime-safety improvements.

entries.title: Yoast SEO
entries.subtitle: Integration engineering
entries.body: Authored the WordProof integration restoration and follow-up fixes across SDK behavior, authentication and editor support, working through upstream review and acceptance tests.

entries.title: Schema.org
entries.subtitle: Timestamping proposal
entries.body: Co-proposed a content-timestamping approach with Yoast, WordProof and structured-data specialists. Contributed analysis of hash verification and cross-chain identifiers.

entries.title: Fastpotify
entries.subtitle: Merged macOS contribution
entries.body: Contributed a Rust/macOS window-lifecycle fix for reopening the player after closing its window.

entries.title: Lighthouse Support & Kompaskamp
entries.subtitle: Project review & facilitation
entries.body: Participate in nonprofit project evaluation and coordination at Lighthouse Support. Co-head leadership for Kompaskamp in 2026. Languages: Dutch and English.

skills: PHP / Laravel; JavaScript / TypeScript; Vue / React; APIs and reusable SDKs; queues and billing; AWS/serverless; PostgreSQL; deployments, migrations and diagnostics; team coordination and technical teaching.
